---

wife of the Rev.

John Frewen Moor, jr.

She married (1853) the Rev.

John Frewen Moor, jr., Vicar of Ampfield. [Erminois].

Through her mother Jane Trench she was a first cousin of Maria (Trench) Wilson, the wife of the Rev.

Robert Wilson, vicar of Rownhams.
